45/S0.subgoal: Explain the purpose and definition of empirical study in usability evaluation.

45/S1.subgoal: Describe the four stages of the empirical research process.

45/S2.subgoal: Distinguish between testable and non-testable research questions using a case study.

45/S3.subgoal: Explain how to balance the trade-off between testability and generality in research questions.

45/S4.subgoal: Define independent and dependent variables in empirical research.

45/S5.subgoal: Summarize the first two stages of the empirical research process.
